info.title: jobber
info.description:
Submit code to run on whatever computers you have. A **job** is a named script in a repo's `jobs.toml`; a **run** is one execution of it at a commit.

- **Submit** a run, with a `priority` if it should jump the queue, see where it waits with `ListQueue`, then follow it: `pending` → `assigned` → `running` → `succeeded`, `failed` or `canceled`.
- **Read its log** with `GetRunLog`, from any byte offset, while it runs and after.
- **Hosts** are the computers that run jobber-host, which registers, holds a connection over which it is sent its runs, and reports their logs and ends through the *Host protocol* calls. You don't call those.

- **Secrets** are set by an admin (`PutSecret`), stored encrypted, and never read back: a run naming them in `secrets` is given each as an environment variable.

**Auth:** `Authorization: Bearer <token>` with the submitters' token, on everything but `GetHealth` and the *Secrets* calls, which take the admin's.

**Errors:** `{code, message}`, where `code` is an AWS-style exception name such as `ValidationException` or `ResourceNotFoundException`.

adminAuth.description: The admin's token, `ADMIN_TOKEN`: it manages secrets, and nothing else.

hostAuth.description: A host's own token, `<host id>.<secret>`, as `RegisterHost` answered it.

commit.description: Full commit sha to check out.

args.description: Arguments appended to the job's command.

priority.description: Higher is placed first; equal ones oldest first. -1000 to 1000.

items.description: A secret's name, which is the environment variable a run is given it in: capitals, digits and `_`.

secrets.description: Secrets its host gives it as environment variables of their names.

onHost.description: Run on the host `requirements.host` names itself, as its user, in the checkout, outside a container. That host's jobber-host runs it only for a repo on its `host_runs` allowlist, and fails it otherwise. Default: false.

state.description: `pending` → `assigned` → `running` → `succeeded`, `failed` or `canceled`. An assignment not taken goes back to `pending`.

reason.description: Why it ended, when not plain (e.g. timed out).

cancelRequested.description: Cancel asked for; its host will stop it.

attempt.description: Which try this is, from 1: the run's other fields are this attempt's.

retryAt.description: A retry waits in the queue until then (ISO 8601).

host.description: Host it is assigned to or ran on.

leaseExpiresAt.description: Fails at this time unless its host's heartbeat renews it.

os.description: Operating system it needs. Default: any.

arch.description: CPU architecture it needs. Default: any.

gpu.description: Whole GPUs, each its container's own. Default: 1 if it names `gpuMemory`, else none; a job whose `jobs.toml` asks for more fails on its host.

gpuMemory.description: MiB of memory each of its GPUs must have: it runs only on a host whose GPUs are at least this large. Default: any.

host.description: Name of the host it must run on, which must be registered. Default: any. A run `onHost` names one.

Requirements.description: What the run needs from its host.

limit.description: Retries after a failed attempt, 0 to 10. Default: 0.

backoff.description: Seconds before the first retry, doubling for each after, at most 3600. Default: 10.

Retry.description: Retries a failed attempt (not a canceled one).

reason.description: Why it ended, when not plain.

logSize.description: Its log's size in bytes: read it with `GetRunLog?attempt=`.

Attempt.description: An earlier attempt of a run.

commit.description: Full commit sha to check out.

labels.description: Labels to find it by, e.g. what it is for and who asked.

priority.description: Higher is placed first; equal ones oldest first. -1000 to 1000. Default: 0.

items.description: A secret's name, which is the environment variable a run is given it in: capitals, digits and `_`.

secrets.description: Secrets its host gives it, each as an environment variable of its name, masked in its log. Each must be set (`PutSecret`). Default: none.

onHost.description: Run on the host `requirements.host` names itself, as its user, in the checkout, outside a container. That host's jobber-host runs it only for a repo on its `host_runs` allowlist, and fails it otherwise. Default: false.

priority.description: Higher is placed first; equal ones oldest first. -1000 to 1000.

token.description: Its own token, `<id>.<secret>`. Shown only once.

version.description: jobber-host version, as it last registered.

features.description: What its jobber-host can do beyond container runs, of `secrets`, `hostRuns`: a run naming secrets goes only to a host with `secrets`, a run `onHost` only to one with `hostRuns`. Others are kept and ignored.

connected.description: Holds a connection open now: the scheduler can push runs to it.

cpu.description: CPUs for runs, a decimal number.

gpuMemory.description: MiB of memory of its smallest GPU, each given whole to one run. Default: 0.

Capacity.description: What the host offers runs: what it measured, less what it keeps back for the rest of the machine.

memory.description: Memory free for runs, in MiB.

gpu.description: Whole GPUs free for runs. Default: 0.

diskFree.description: Free disk where runs work, in MiB.

cpus.description: CPUs the machine has, all of them; 0 if unknown.

name.description: Unique host name. Registering it again keeps its id.

features.description: What its jobber-host can do beyond container runs, of `secrets`, `hostRuns`: a run naming secrets goes only to a host with `secrets`, a run `onHost` only to one with `hostRuns`. Others are kept and ignored.

cancel.description: Of those runs, the ones to stop and complete as `canceled`.

ended.description: Of those runs, the ones no longer running on this host (e.g. failed by a lapsed lease): stop them, without completing them.

lease.description: Seconds before a run fails without another heartbeat.

allOf.description: What the host has free for runs now: its capacity less what its runs and image builds hold.

running.description: Runs it is running: their leases are renewed.

name.description: A secret's name, which is the environment variable a run is given it in: capitals, digits and `_`.

Secret.description: A secret, without its value: no call returns that.

value.description: The value, up to 64 KiB. Stored encrypted; never returned.

size.description: Log size: where the next append starts.

reason.description: Why, if not plain (e.g. `timed out after 600s`).

post.description: Queues a run as `pending`, by `priority` then age, until a host that meets its requirements takes it. The repo isn't checked here: a missing job fails on its host. Refused if a secret it names is not set, if `requirements.host` names no registered host, or if it is `onHost` without one.

get.description: The `pending` runs in the order the scheduler places them: highest `priority` first, then oldest. The first is next to go to a host that fits it; one no host fits is passed over, not waited for, and one waiting out a retry's backoff is listed with its `retryAt`. Move a run with `UpdateRunPriority`.

delete.description: Takes a host that is gone or renamed out of `ListHosts`, and no run is placed on it. Its runs, their attempts and logs are kept. Refused while a run is `assigned` to it or `running` on it: cancel those, or wait for them to end. If that host heartbeats again with its token, or registers again under its name, it is back in `ListHosts` with the same id: one still connected is back at its next heartbeat.
